description: This file defines an internal static class 'MembershipTableEntryExtensions' with an extension method 'HasMissedIAmAlives' for 'MembershipEntry'. The method checks if the 'IAmAlive' message has been missed based on the last effective time and allowed miss period, which relates to cluster membership health monitoring.

classes.name: MembershipTableEntryExtensions
classes.description: An internal static class that provides extension methods for membership entry objects in the Orleans clustering framework.

methods.name: HasMissedIAmAlives
methods.description: Extension method that determines if the 'IAmAlive' message has been missed for a given membership entry based on the last effective time and the allowed miss period specified in cluster options.
